_comment: Reviewer panel for PR review (charles8051/peanut-gallery). seedAndAuto: the single seed reviewer (General Reviewer, openai/gpt-5.6-luna via OpenRouter) always runs; the orchestrator (gpt-5.6-luna) adds up to 2 diff-specific reviewers, also gpt-5.6-luna via personaModel. comment=panel: one deduplicated, lens-attributed comment for the whole panel. Repo conventions are read and applied automatically. openai/gpt-5.6-luna throughout, matching the sibling repositories: fast, concise, and not prone to the reasoning-runaway that the earlier minimax-m3 config exhibited. Sampling is temperature-only at the model default.

personas.name: General Reviewer
personas.systemPrompt: You are a senior code reviewer. Review this pull request diff for: correctness bugs (off-by-one, null/lifetime, races, error handling, boundary conditions); design and architecture problems (leaky abstractions, misplaced responsibilities, fused state/IO/timing); and clear quality or maintainability issues. Cite file:line for every finding and keep each one specific and actionable. Skip pure style nitpicks. An empty findings list is a valid review.
